headline: Denied four appeals of motor vehicle assessed values; granted five handicapped-vehicle exemption requests.
summary: Four appeals of motor vehicle assessed values were denied because the MSRP is used under the state law that took effect October 1, 2024. Five requests for an ECC exemption for handicapped vehicles were granted. One owner was told to return in March 2027.
decisions: Told the owner of the 2020 FRHT Cascadia appeal to return in March 2027.
Denied the appeal of the assessed value of the 2017 Mazda CX-5 (Hebert, Leo); MSRP of $30,965 used.
Denied the appeal of the assessed value of the 2017 Ford Expedition (Hebert, Leo).
Denied the appeal of the assessed value of the 2020 Autumn Ridge 23RLS Camper (Hebert, Leo).
Granted the ECC exemption request for the 2010 Toyota Sienna C Sport (Jehnings, Kathleen F).
Granted the ECC exemption request for the 2013 Toyota Sienna X Sport (Lachance Richard).
Granted the ECC exemption request for the 2016 Chrysler Pacifica (Lachance Richard).
Granted the ECC exemption request for the 2017 Jeep Cherokee Wagon (Stevens, Dave L.).
Granted the ECC exemption request for the 2018 Chevrolet Colorado Pick-up Truck (Mangum, Thomas).
Denied the appeal of the assessed value of the 2018 Audi A8L (Aviles, Jorge).

plain_text:
1 
 
 
 
MINUTES 
September 15, 2026 - Tuesday 
 
BOARD OF ASSESSMENT APPEALS 
2025 Motor Vehicle 
2025 Supplemental Motor Vehicle 
 
Present: Ann Maire Heering, Chairperson of the Board of Appeals 
  Greg Klimek, Board Member 
  Liza Salgado-Sirko, Board Member  
  Michele A. Ososki, Secretary of the Board 
 
The meeting was called to order at 3:02 p.m. on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 in the first floor 
Meeting Room No. 1-2 (#114) at the Bristol City Hall, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, 
Connecticut. 
 
The Board of Assessment Appeals heard the following appeals in the afternoon session on:  
 
 ELIF LLC – 2020 FRHT Cascadia   
 Hebert, Leo – 2017 Ford Expedition 
 Hebert, Leo – 2017 Mazda CX-5   
 Hebert, Leo – 2020 Autumn Ridge 23RLS Camper    
 
A motion was made by Ann Marie Heering, Board Chairperson, to adjourn the afternoon appeal 
hearing with a second to the motion made by Greg Klimek, Board Member and it was 
unanimous to adjourn hearings at 4:00 p.m.  
 
The Board of Assessment Appeal reconvened for its evening appeal hearings at 5:57 p.m. on 
September 15, 2026:   
 
- Aviles, Jorge – 2018 Audi A8L  
 
1. ELIF LLC – 2020 FRHT Cascadia   
 
 Appellant:  The owner of the truck didn’t sigh an authorized agent statement to allow 
his room-mate to represent him.    
 Board:  The Board informed owner to come back in March of 2027.
2 
 
Next order of business was to discuss a date in November to set the upcoming 2027 March and 
September hearing dates.    The Board decider on November 5, 2026 (Thursday) at 10:00 a.m. 
 
2. Hebert, Leo – 2017 Mazda CX-5   
 
 Appellant:  Requesting the assessed value be reduced as the motor vehicle has high 
mileage and damage.    
 Board:  Petition Denied.  Price Digest states the MSRP is $30,965.  As of October 1, 
2024 the state changed the law and moving forward the MSRP will be utilized from 
Price Digest with a depreciation schedule applied.   
 
3. Hebert, Leo – 2017 Ford Expedition   
 
 Appellant:  Disagreed with the assessed value placed on the vehicle.  The Board 
explained the new law as of October 1, 2024 in regards in utilizing the MSRP.    
 Board:  Petition Denied.  The MSRP is correct.  
 
4. Hebert, Leo – 2020 Autumn Ridge 23RLS Camper     
 
 Appellant:  Disagreed with the assessed value placed on the camper.  The Board 
explained the new law as of October 1, 2024 in regards in utilizing the MSRP.    
 Board:  Petition Denied.  The MSRP is correct.  
 
The following appeals were deliberated by the Power of Board on September 15, 2026:  
 
5. Jehnings, Kathleen F – 2010 Toyota Sienna C Sport    
 
 Appellant:  Application submitted to receive the ECC exemption in regards to a 
handicapped motor vehicle.   
 Board:  Petition Granted.    
 
6. Lachance Richard – 2013 Toyota Sienna X Sport  
 
 Appellant:  Application submitted to receive the ECC exemption in regards to a 
handicapped motor vehicle.   
 Board:  Petition Granted.    
 
7. Lachance Richard – 2016 Chrysler Pacifica  
 
 Appellant:  Application submitted to receive the ECC exemption in regards to a 
handicapped motor vehicle.   
 Board:  Petition Granted.
3 
 
 
8. Stevens, Dave L. – 2017 Jeep Cherokee Wagon     
 
 Appellant:  Application submitted to receive the ECC exemption in regards to a 
handicapped motor vehicle.   
 Board:  Petition Granted.     
 
9. Mangum, Thomas – 2018 Chevrolet Colorado Pick-up Truck    
 
 Appellant:  Application submitted to receive the ECC exemption in regards to a 
handicapped motor vehicle.   
 Board:  Petition Granted  
 
10. Aviles, Jorge – 2018 Audi A8L  
 
 Appellant:  Disagreed with the assessed value placed on the vehicle.  The Board 
explained the new law as of October 1, 2024 in regards in utilizing the MSRP.    
 Board:  Petition Denied.  The MSRP is correct.  
 
A motion was made by Ann Marie Heering, Chairperson, to adjourn appeal hearings with a 
second to the motion made by Greg Klimek, Board Member and it was unanimous to adjourn 
hearings at 7:00 p.m.  
 
Summary of appeals: 
 
Appeals Approved = 0 
Appeals Denied = 4 
Appeals Power of the Board = 5  
Appeals Withdrawn = 1 
Total Appeals = 10  
 
Submitted by Michele Ososki, Secretary of the Board of Appeals
